headline: Africa Made It Initiative Targets $34 Billion GDP Boost Through Local Garment Processing
summary: The 'Africa Made It' movement launched a campaign in Lagos to shift from raw cotton exports to local garment manufacturing. The initiative aims to capture $34 billion in annual GDP by fostering industrial sovereignty across the continent.
why: Many African economies rely heavily on raw commodity exports, leaving them vulnerable to price volatility and missing out on value-added manufacturing opportunities. Industrialization is a key policy goal for regional development.

impacts.name: Textile Manufacturing
impacts.why: Local processing initiatives are intended to increase domestic industrial output.
